name: Hush
summary: Turns down villagers, farm animals, nether portals, rain, minecarts and anvils without muting any of them.
logoPrompt: A note block wrapped in a thick white wool blanket, with a few small musical notes fading out above it

bullets: Hurt sounds stay at full volume

description: **Hush turns down the everyday sounds that wear on you after an hour of play, without taking any of them away.**
- Villagers and wandering traders mutter, trade and grumble at about a third of their usual volume.
- Cows, sheep, chickens and pigs are quieter around your farm.
- Nether portals hum at a quarter of their volume, and so does the whoosh when you travel.
- Rain is a bit under half as loud.
- Riding a minecart and using or dropping an anvil sound calmer.
Put the zip into the `resourcepacks` folder of your game, then turn it on under Options > Resource Packs.
- Made for Minecraft: Java Edition 1.21 and 1.21.1. It only changes sound volumes, so you can add or remove it at any time.
- Hurt and death sounds stay at full volume, so you still hear when something is in trouble. Every sound keeps its subtitle.
- Only players who install it hear the difference, on servers too.
- New features arrive with updates, see each file's changelog.
Found a bug or know a sound that should be quieter? Leave a comment.
